shortDescription: IBPS RRB CRP XV 2026 recruitment for 13,706 indicative posts. Online registration and fee payment are open from 01 September 2026 to 21 September 2026.
content:
Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the CRP RRBs XV notification for recruitment of Office Assistants (Multipurpose) and Officers Scale-I, II and III in Regional Rural Banks.

The notification lists 13,706 indicative vacancies: 8,183 Office Assistants, 4,256 Officer Scale-I, 1,047 Officer Scale-II cadres and 220 Officer Scale-III posts. Vacancies are indicative and final allotment depends on vacancies reported by participating RRBs.

Important Dates

  • Online registration and fee payment: 01 September 2026 to 21 September 2026
  • Edit window: For 2 days after registration closes, as notified by IBPS
  • Pre-exam training: November 2026
  • Preliminary examination: November / December 2026
  • Main / Single examination: December 2026 to February 2027
  • Provisional allotment: February / March 2027

Application Fee

SC/ST/PwBD candidates pay Rs.175. Office Assistant ESM/DESM candidates are also charged Rs.175. All other candidates pay Rs.850, inclusive of GST.

How to Apply

  1. Visit ibps.in.
  2. Open the CRP RRBs XV application link.
  3. Apply separately for each eligible cadre and pay the fee for each application.
  4. Upload the required documents and submit the form by 21 September 2026.
  5. Save the final application and e-receipt.

Read the official notification for state-wise vacancies, local-language requirements, educational qualifications, experience and exam structure before applying.
